text:
[LSER.14.1] A line's time-model phrase declares over what window
of the slot's history the aggregations apply. Four forms:

| Phrase | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `all_time` | from first observation onward, no forgetting |
| `sliding <dur>` | true sliding window of width `<dur>`: at read time `t`, the half-open interval `(t−<dur>, t]` — a sample exactly `<dur>` old is outside it ([LSIG.2.2.4]) |
| `tumbling <dur>` | non-overlapping consecutive windows of width `<dur>`; aggregations read the **most-recent-completed** window. Refused in this edition ([LSER.14.4.5]) |
| `sample <n>` | uniform random sample of size `n` from the unbounded stream (reservoir; see [LSMP]) |
